newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

** Automobile giant PT Astra International said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 340.85 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996, compared with 271.41 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Astra said it expected a net profit of 450 billion rupiah for 1996 rising to 614 billion rupiah in 1997.
** The Dow Jones industrial average fell 29.07 points to close at 6,061.80 on Tuesday as investors sold technology companies after Digital Equipment Corp reported a bigger-than-expected loss.

** The Jakarta composite index closed 0.12 percent, or 0.66 points, lower at 571.81 points on Tuesday with the focus remaining on car manufacturer Astra International and cigarette company HM Sampoerna.
** On Wednesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,324.75/25.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,324.20/25.20.
** Astra on reports the firm had revised up its 1996 net profit forecast due to continued strong sales of its motorcycle division.
** Sampoerna on news the cigarette giant was willing to sell its large stake in Astra.
** Bakrie Finance Corporation on reports the firm planned to acquire three local financial firms.
** Rimba Niaga Idola on market talk that the trading firm was likely to announce a rights issue later this month.
